measured_precisely: what a business call answers while the daemon is down
that the same conversation, agent and epoch come back after a restart
that the recovery answer is truncated at 8192 characters and how to read it honestly
method: `tsunagou daemon stop` on the isolated project, then the enrolled conversation called context__project_read; then `tsunagou daemon start` and the same conversation called again
not_measured: a running attempt's reservation held across the outage window (no attempt was running when the daemon stopped)
whether a retry issued by the bridge itself, rather than by the caller, would have succeeded

after_restart.reading: the same Agent and the same Tsunagou session came back unchanged, so the outage did not cost an enrolment or advance the epoch. The 8192-character truncation is the host behaviour the second review identified; the identity fields were recovered with the prefix decoder rather than guessed from the cut body.

call_during_the_outage.reading: a clean failure. Nothing was reported as succeeded, no partial result was invented, and the bridge kept its own credential rather than discarding it.

why: task.lifecycle and recovery.idempotent_reconnect both listed owner and resource facts during an outage as never inspected. The previous round only restarted the daemon between turns; this one stops it while a conversation is asking.
